parent_objective: audit the artifact-only scenario-quality discriminant panel before scenario redesign, repair-plan design, synthesis, or stop
blocked_by: M2452 created a discriminant panel that must be audited before any scenario redesign, repair, or training route
stable avoidable and AES feasible rows are hard-offtrack dominated
handling-limit and hidden-dynamics rows remain possible repair-plan candidates but require guardrails
supersedes: direct scenario redesign from M2452 without audit
direct repair/training from M2452 panel rows
ranking profiles, packs, selected checkpoints, candidate families, or panel rows as winners

public_gates: M2453 must audit M2452 summary, panel, guardrail, and decision rows
M2453 must decide whether the panel supports scenario redesign, guarded repair-plan design, synthesis, or stop
M2453 must preserve monitoring axes as non-ranking and no-winner
M2453 must not rerun rollout, repair, train, rank, select winners, or make paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank panel rows as winners
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the M2452 discriminant panel supports a bounded scenario-quality, repair-plan, synthesis, or stop route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if the panel cannot support a bounded next route
stop if scenario-quality blockers and repair candidates are conflated
stop if monitoring axes are treated as rankings
stop if direct repair or training is proposed without an audited guardrail plan
fallback_plan: route to scenario redesign design if stable/AES task-quality blockers dominate
route to guarded repair-plan design only if repair-candidate scope is narrow enough and guardrails are explicit
route to branch synthesis if both routes remain broad
stop for user review if no bounded route is supported

allowed_updates: M2453 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2452 panel is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2453 audits scenario-quality panel evidence and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2453; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the audit shows stable/AES blockers dominate or repair candidates are too broad, route to scenario-quality design or branch synthesis instead of repair/training.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a new scenario-quality discriminant panel before choosing the next branch step
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether current-sim should route to scenario redesign, guarded repair-plan design, synthesis, or stop
must_synthesize_if: audit cannot choose a bounded next route
another artifact-only relabel is proposed without new evidence
monitoring axes are treated as ranking

hypothesis: Auditing M2452 can decide whether the discriminant panel supports scenario redesign, guarded repair-plan design, synthesis, or stop without rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2452 summary, panel rows, guardrail rows, and decision rows are audited
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped
no rerun repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2453 reruns measured validation or policy action
M2453 ranks candidate families, controller families, selected checkpoints, or panel rows as winners
M2453 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2453 passes if it audits M2452 and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
